finalText:
Found it: `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` merged layers with a shallow `Object.assign`, so any override touching `output` or `sourcemap` wiped out the sibling keys instead of layering on top of them. That's why `packages/shared/config.js` threw and the build stopped right after the lint/dedup output.

Fixed it with a one-level merge that combines nested objects (`output`, `sourcemap`) key-by-key instead of replacing them wholesale, so defaults → package overrides → CLI flags all layer correctly without needing every override to spell out every key.

`verify.js` now passes clean.
